source: Native vLLM measurements on one DGX Spark, 2026-10-07. Trained seed-0 heads; both CE checkpoints use the original final-layer recipe.
memory_metric: Peak PyTorch CUDA allocator reserved bytes during the whole batched workload, including weights, KV tensors, workspaces/activations and allocator slack. Excludes non-PyTorch/context allocations; GB10 shares host/GPU memory.
latency_metric: Median of 50 warm sequential batch-one first-decision responses, pre-tokenized engine inputs; excludes tokenization, HTTP and queueing.

protocol.head_dtype: FP32 for the small trainable heads
protocol.all_models_use: causal native pooling, full teacher uses original full-vocabulary LM head

clm_cache.memory_scope: sum encoder-worker and head/cache-process CUDA reserved memory

validation: 20 held-out workload rows compared with the HF feature cache. Teacher strict agreement 18/20, all 20 agree allowing the two exact HF top ties; maximum probability error 0.057, mean 0.003. Head agreements: 20/20 for FunDM, FunDM+1T, CE; 19/20 for CE+1T. These validate the readout; accuracy tables remain HF evaluations. Released CLM agrees on all 20 reference Engine decisions; mean probability error 0.003, maximum 0.024.

memory_throughput.peak_allocated_scope: sum of per-process maxima (upper bound); the reported peak reserved bytes are simultaneous end-of-pass reservations, retained by both allocators
